description: This file defines an internal class `_Await` that encapsulates delayed execution in PyTorch's JIT framework, including associated metaclass and type annotations. It provides wrappers for asynchronous operations like `awaitable`, `awaitable_wait`, and `awaitable_nowait`, enabling scripting and eager execution modes.

classes.name: _Await
classes.description: A wrapper class around `torch._C._Await` that adds generic typing and scripting capabilities for delayed execution in PyTorch.

methods.name: _PyAwaitMeta
methods.description: A metaclass that combines the metaclass of `torch._C._Await` with `typing.Generic`, enabling `Generic[W]` support in `_Await`.

methods.name: _Await
methods.description: Main class providing an interface for delayed execution, supporting scripting and eager modes, with methods to obtain awaitable results and check properties like `is_nowait`.
